content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Soil pH mapping has been conducted at fine scale in alkaline Vojvodina soils using ion-selective electrode field measurements combined with regression-kriging to reduce laboratory costs while maintaining accuracy for management decisions.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08251","field":"abstract","quote":"ion-selective electrode rapid measurements and regression-kriging in alkaline agricultural land"}]},{"text":"Geostatistical methods including kriging with external drift and regression-kriging have been applied to map multiple soil properties such as pH, electrical conductivity, organic carbon, and particle size distribution across Pannonian region sites with guidance on variogram modelling and uncertainty quantification.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08249","field":"abstract","quote":"variogram modelling, ordinary kriging, kriging with external drift, and regression-kriging for soil property mapping"}]},{"text":"Rapid proximal sensing methods including portable XRF have been validated for estimating soil chemical composition across depth profiles in saline-sodic Pannonian Plain sites, with depth-specific calibration improving predictive accuracy.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-05388","field":"abstract","quote":"Depth-specific calibration equations were more accurate than a single pooled model"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has demonstrated expertise in spatial pH mapping and multi-property geostatistical modelling in Vojvodina [SYN-PUB-08251, SYN-PUB-08249], but published work does not address soil buffer capacity modelling, liming dose recommendation algorithms, or calibration of recommendations to specific soil texture and organic matter classes."}
